correctness.rationale: Window-shifting lemma reduces each maximum to the two 1-run starts; explicit prefix formulas prove the exact defect for all lengths and positive run lengths. A necessary longest-run start gives the existence equivalence, including ties and periodic powers. Counting the half-turn equivalence on run quadruples gives both rational series. The verifier independently enumerates all phases and factors for 2401 parameter quadruples and 650 seeded larger cases, and checks the series for 32 lengths.

evidence: Cunha et al. (arXiv:1702.01280) reduce maximum-one windows in run-length encoded finite strings to windows beginning at runs; this provides a general tool analogous to Step 1, not a closed equality obstruction on cyclic four-run configurations.

An accessible previous general run-sorting assertion says a run-sorted infinite periodic rearrangement dominates maximum-one windows under independent reordering of the runs, giving the sufficiency direction for opposed length order but neither a necessary obstruction for a fixed circle nor a quantitative defect and necklace count.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The current theorem refines a more general sufficient sorted-arrangement construction: it proves the strict failure of every cyclic phase in the incorrectly ordered case, computes its deficit and enumerates all successes and failures. Those outcomes are not logical consequences of a non-strict rearrangement upper bound alone.

originality.rationale: The searched primary literature defines finite/infinite prefix normal forms and gives general run-start indexing, but no identified theorem establishes the sharp cyclic four-run phase obstruction, quantified defect and success/failure necklace enumeration together. A previously recorded general run-sorting result provides a sufficient arrangement but does not imply strict failure for other cyclic arrangements. value.rationale: This natural four-run cyclic family is the first alternating two-one-run/two-zero-run model with a nontrivial question whether its canonical infinite prefix-normal form occurs as an actual phase. The exact obstruction, sharp phase defect, and complete cyclic necklace success/failure counts give an all-length structural classification relevant to cyclic jumbled-factor representations; the result is not presented as a generic indexing breakthrough.
